# J & C Lewis Construction Group

J & C Lewis Construction Group is a custom metalwork contractor based in Bellmead, TX, bringing 35 years of combined experience to Central Texas and beyond. They design and fabricate custom metal fences, gates, and ornamental ironwork built to last for decades. Licensed and insured.

- **Website URL**: https://www.jandclewisconstruction.com
- **Phone**: (254) 332-1303
- **Email**: john.jandclewis@gmail.com
- **Address**: Bellmead, TX 76705
- **Locations Served**: Bellmead, Waco, Temple, Austin, Dallas, Fort Worth, Corsicana, Gatesville, McGregor, Odessa, Collin County, and surrounding areas across Texas.

## Core Services

### Custom Metal Fences
Precision-built metal fencing that combines security with style — designed and fabricated to exact specifications, built to protect and impress for decades.

### Custom Metal Gates
Custom metal gates designed for strength and curb appeal, crafted to complement the property and stand up to daily use at every entrance.

### Ornamental Ironwork
Handcrafted ornamental ironwork that elevates any space — from decorative railings to intricate architectural details, fusing artistry with structural integrity.
